# MASE IDE adapter

Before changing or reviewing this project, read `project-rules.md`. It is the only maintained rule source.

Hard minimum: confirm user-visible behavior; test before implementation; analyze impact before historical behavior changes and reconcile the actual diff; keep API contracts and P0 E2E green; diagnose root causes; back up before destructive migration. For releases, bind an immutable artifact identity, verify live consumer behavior, and retain tested recovery through observation. Keep product code, data, backups, demos, and generated caches outside the MASE framework repository. Load detailed docs and Skill references only when the current Profile, risk, or task routes to them.
